newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-SWISS DEFENDER HENCHOZ SET TO JOIN BLACKBURN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SWISS DEFENDER HENCHOZ SET TO JOIN BLACKBURN.

text.p: Swiss defender Stephane Henchoz is set to join English premier league Blackburn from Hamburg for a fee estimated at around seven million marks ($4.0 million).
"Blackburn have agreed to our conditions," Hamburg manager Bernd Wehmeyer said. "We just need one final discussion."
Henchoz's move gives him the chance to link up with coach Roy Hodgson who enjoyed a good relationship with the player when he was in charge of the Swiss national side.
Henchoz was contracted to the German club until the year 2000.
